findings.body: A resumed upgrade fix with a staged rename produces a record such as `R  new.txt\0old.txt\0`. Slicing every NUL-separated entry by three characters returns `new.txt` and `.txt`, corrupting the source filename. Upgrade passes these paths to `repo.commit_state` at src/forge/upgrade.py:150; its `git add` at src/forge/repo.py:468 then fails on the nonexistent path, preventing the rerun from committing and closing. This previously reported P2 remains unresolved. Disable rename detection for this listing or parse both filename fields explicitly, as required by the [Git status contract](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-status).
findings.title: Parse both filenames in staged rename records
